slots.ev: 白天回市場，她從小就在這些攤子之間長大

ppl.act: 在攤子前挑海鮮、跟攤商講價
ppl.wear: 釜山市場白天的樣子，防水圍裙的攤商、拎著袋子的客人

slots.pl: 釜山海鮮市場的走道，白天，水箱在兩側
slots.pl_en: in the aisle of the Busan seafood market in the daytime, tanks along both sides
slots.ac: 她一手接過攤商遞來的東西，正要轉頭回話
slots.ac_en: She is taking something handed to her with one hand, already turning to answer.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：家裡在市場旁邊開店，她從小就在攤子之間長大
slots.of: 市場藍色的寬版襯衫，袖子捲起來，裡面是白色貼身
slots.of_en: a market-blue oversized shirt with the sleeves rolled, something white and fitted underneath
slots.li: 市場頂棚把白天的光濾成均勻的散射光，水箱反回來一點
slots.li_en: The market canopy filters the daylight into an even wash and the tanks throw a little of it back.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「市場的雜訊。高飽和、貼近」
slots.fa_en: She is mid-sentence, her face wide open with it.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：大聲、熱情、腔調很重
slots.hair_en: down and pushed back behind both ears

slots.ev: 深夜的路邊攤，吃之前先撩頭髮到耳後——那是她的招牌鏡頭

ppl.act: 在隔壁桌吃東西、跟老闆點單
ppl.wear: 深夜出來吃宵夜的人，外套、運動服

slots.pl: 釜山一個深夜的路邊攤，一張小桌，鍋子的蒸氣在上來
slots.pl_en: at a Busan street stall late at night, one small table, steam coming up off the pot
slots.ac: 她坐下來先把頭髮撩到耳後，另一手已經拿著筷子
slots.ac_en: She has sat down and is tucking her hair behind her ear first, chopsticks already in her other hand.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：吃之前一定先撩頭髮到耳後，那是她的招牌鏡頭
slots.li: 攤子那一盞燈在她正前方，攤子以外全暗，蒸氣在光裡
slots.li_en: The stall's one lamp is directly in front of her, everything beyond the stall is dark, and the steam sits in the light.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「食物特寫要有油光與熱氣」
slots.fa: 嘴角已經在笑，看著鏡頭
slots.fa_en: Already smiling at the corners, looking at the lens.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：句子常常被嘴巴裡的東西打斷
slots.hair_en: long, one side being tucked behind her ear

slots.ev: 吃完宵夜回房間，什麼都不想做
slots.pl: 她房間的床上，深夜，宵夜的袋子還丟在地上
slots.pl_en: on the bed in her room late at night, the bag from supper still dropped on the floor
slots.ac: 她半躺在床上一隻手臂撐著頭，另一隻手垂在床邊
slots.ac_en: She is half lying on the bed propped up on one arm, her other hand hanging over the edge.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：吃完宵夜回房間，寬版 T 恤底下的鬆感、床上、深夜暖光
slots.of: 寬版白色 T 恤，領口滑到一邊肩膀
slots.of_en: an oversized white T-shirt with the neckline slipped off one shoulder
slots.of_s: 私下核心：寬版 T 恤底下的鬆感
slots.li: 床頭一盞暖燈在她側前方，房間其餘部分暗
slots.li_en: One warm bedside lamp reaches her from the side and in front, the rest of the room dark.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「私下場景改為低光暖調」
slots.fa_en: Thoroughly lazy, but her eyes on the lens.
slots.fa_s: 私下核心：私人平台上她把這件事講得更直接
slots.hair_en: down and messy against the pillow

slots.ev: 手機相簿滑到底全部都是食物，她自己都笑了
slots.pl: 她房間的地板上，背靠著床，深夜
slots.pl_en: on the floor of her room with her back against the bed, late at night
slots.ac: 她一手拿著手機在滑，另一手撐在地板上
slots.ac_en: She is scrolling with one hand, the other braced on the floor.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：手機相簿全是食物
slots.of: 木色系的寬鬆家居長褲配貼身細肩帶上衣
slots.of_en: loose wood-toned home trousers with a fitted strappy top
slots.li: 手機螢幕的光加上床頭燈，兩個光源都在她前方偏低，背後全暗
slots.li_en: The glow of the phone and the bedside lamp both sit low in front of her, and everything behind her is dark.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「私下場景改為低光暖調」
slots.fa_en: Laughing at it on her own.
slots.fa_s: 幽默：很會拿自己的食量開玩笑
slots.screen_ok: 手機螢幕上是她自己拍的食物照片，守則不得要求螢幕只能有純表面
slots.hair_en: tied up in a loose knot

slots.ev: 遠征到別的城市找吃的，市場白天正熱鬧

ppl.act: 在攤子前排隊、端著吃的站著吃
ppl.wear: 來吃早市的在地人，短袖、圍裙、提著袋子

slots.pl: 另一個城市的傳統市場外圍，白天，攤子沿街排開
slots.pl_en: along the outer edge of a traditional market in another city in the daytime, stalls set out down the street
slots.ac: 她兩手各拿一樣邊走邊吃，正在看下一攤
slots.ac_en: She is walking with something in each hand, eating as she goes and already looking at the next stall.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：拍了幾支在市場吃東西的影片，數字好到她乾脆全職做
slots.of: 紅色短袖上衣配寬版長褲
slots.of_en: a red short-sleeved top with wide trousers
slots.li: 白天的天光很亮，攤子的遮陽布把光染成暖的
slots.li_en: The daylight is bright and the stall awnings tint it warm as it comes through.
slots.fa: 嘴裡有東西，表情很滿足
slots.hair_en: tied back with strands falling loose
